adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the sync-enabled branch returns the raw `fetch(...)` result (a `Response`), while the non-sync branch returns whatever each integration’s `refreshFunction()` returns (often an object with `.data`, or a provider-specific token object). This mismatch is visible in the diff: e.g. Google Calendar (`googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`) does `const token = res?.data;` assuming a `.data` shape, but if `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, `res` will be a `Response` with no `.data`. Similarly HubSpot (`hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`) expects a `HubspotToken` object but could receive a `Response`. So beyond being untyped, the abstraction is behaviorally inconsistent and would break integrations when the sync path is active.
